newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery no longer underwriter on Steiner IPO.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery no longer underwriter on Steiner IPO.

text.p: Montgomery Securities said on Friday that it was no longer lead underwriter or part of the syndicate for an initial public offering of Steiner Leisure Ltd.
In July, the company filed to offer 5.4 million shares at an estimated price of $11 to $13 under the proposed stock symbol "STNRF".
Montgomery said it had no further details, and company officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
Steiner Leisure is a provider of hair, beauty, massage and fitness services, and skin and hair-care products aboard cruise ships.
